paragraphs.text:
Gritting your teeth and steeling your heart, you sink to your 
hands and knees, and crawl to the top of the rise like a forest 
lynx. You peer over the top and see the thing that has attacked 
Bernard.
Make a Sanity roll: if you fail, lose 1D6 Sanity. Then, go to 166.
